title: Add full jitter to the retry helper

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: During a payment-provider brownout all our workers retried in lockstep (synchronized exponential backoff) and made the outage worse. Add jitter to the shared retry helper.
constraints: The payment provider allows at most 3 attempts per charge; exceeding it gets the merchant account throttled.
Keep the retry() signature backward compatible.
input.context: Payments service (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types). retry() is used by chargeWithRetry() and a few other callers.

ground_truth.material_issue: The loop now runs from 0 to attempts inclusive, i.e. attempts + 1 calls (4 charges attempts instead of 3), violating the provider limit. Existing test 'makes exactly `attempts` calls when every call fails' fails.
required_observations: Violates the 3-attempt provider limit / existing test fails
